items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: Every year I played by Miss Commander.

ctx.x: It's a beautiful place. All air conditioning in there. They got around about 500 small tables. I know the Acme Insurance Company is fixing to give their Christmas card up there. I told them about a place. They asked me where they think they'd be able to get a place. And when I was charging my band, I told them what I asked them. Well, for them, I charged them $135 for seven pieces of music. That's a Christmas party. Now, every year I played by Miss Commander. You ever been there?

items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: Every year, I played by Miss Commander.

ctx.x: It's a beautiful place. All air conditioning in there. They got around about 500 some more tables. I know the Acme Insurance Company is fixing to give their Christmas party up there. I told them about a place. They asked me where they think they'd be able to get a place. And I would charge my band. I told them what I asked them. Well, for them, I charge them $135 for seven pieces of music. That's a Christmas party. Now, every year, I played by Miss Commander. You ever been there? No.
